items.title: Swiss Mobile Brand Gomo's Chatbot Reportedly Gave Wrong Roaming Advice Before a Teenager Received an Unexpected Bill
items.summary: A chatbot for Swiss mobile brand Gomo reportedly told a father that his teenage daughter's plan included up to 3 GB of data for a school trip to France. She received a roaming bill of about CHF 44 despite using less than 3 GB. Her father said he would have bought a data package had he known one was required. Salt Mobile, which operates Gomo, confirmed the chatbot error and said it would reimburse the charges.
